references.excerpt: The earlier adaptive phase 2 I-SPY2 report estimated pCR of 60% versus 22% in its triple-negative subgroup against its own chemotherapy control. That is a different comparison from KEYNOTE-522 and cannot establish a cross-trial treatment ranking. Likewise, better survival among people who achieve pCR is a prognostic association within selected response groups, not proof of the postoperative drug's separate effect or a validated rule selecting individual benefit. CTNeoBC found a strong pCR-outcome association but did not validate pCR as a trial-level surrogate for EFS or OS in its included trials. Here survival itself was measured.
